pairs.subject: alerting
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy-simulator/index.tsx:49 The 'Balance Alerts' are verdicts the simulator works out from a Monte Carlo run the user starts by hand, shown in a tab; nothing is fired, stored as a fire record, delivered or interrupted, so the subject's precondition (rules over collected signals that claim human attention) does not hold. A case-insensitive search of sub_inventory/ for acknowledg, lastFired, quietHours, snooze and toast found nothing; 'cooldown' appears only as the cooldownReduction stat label and 'Alert Sound' is an in-game loot-filter style field.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy-simulator/index.tsx:41 A one-shot simulation the user starts by clicking; there is no evaluator watching a live signal.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy-simulator/AlertCard.tsx:17 There is a third 'unmeasured' state that is never shown as green, which matches the spirit of the technique, but it covers simulation coverage, not a metric that stopped arriving.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy-simulator/constants.ts:41 Severity only picks a colour; there is no reach or routing. ALERT_COLORS (info/warning/critical) is an unused second severity vocabulary next to VerdictState (warn/critical).

pairs.subject: alerting
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/UnifiedSummaryView/index.tsx:74 Severity here only filters which insights are counted on badges in a dashboard that is computed while the view is open. The golden path's line 21 puts status badges outside alerting. Nothing is fired, stored, delivered or acknowledged. A search of HolisticHealthView/ and UnifiedSummaryView/ for acknowledg, lastFired, quietHours, snooze and fireRecord found nothing (the one 'escalation' hit is about a scope banner).

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/HolisticHealthView/useHolisticHealthView.tsx:69 Health is computed again only when the mounted view's inputs change. Nothing evaluates rules; this is a display refresh.
src/components/modules/evaluator/UnifiedSummaryView/index.tsx:76 Good news is a band on the same severity axis, as the golden path suggests, but it only drives badge rendering; nothing is routed.
src/components/modules/evaluator/HolisticHealthView/constants.ts:24 An 'inactive' signal status exists as a neutral colour, but there are no rules to apply a no-data policy to.
